up: Retrieve the ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name) for molecules that have a structural representation in the compound_structures table and whose preferred name is not null. Return each molecule only once. Do not include molecules without a structure or with a null pref_name. No additional filters or sorting required.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.pref_name IS NOT NULL;
